paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 位置生成内部理由（thought）以帮助预测后续文本 [S1.p2]。方法上采用 tokenwise 并行采样、可学习的 thought 起止 meta-token、mixing head 以及扩展的 teacher-forcing 技术 [abstract]。在 Mistral 7B 上继续预训练后，模型在 GSM8K 和 CommonsenseQA 上取得零样本提升，并在自然文本的困难 token 上降低困惑度 [abstract]。作者认为这朝着更通用、可扩展的 LM 推理方式迈出了一步 [S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在几乎所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心策划的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者指出，已有让 LM 从自身推理中学习的方法多聚焦于单个任务或预定义任务集合，依赖人工策划的数据集，限制了推理的规模和泛化性 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
methods for allowing LMs to learn from their reasoning (e.g.,) have focused on solving individual tasks or predefined sets of tasks (e.g.,).
Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
QA datasets, especially high-quality ones, require thoughtful curation and will inherently only ever cover a subset of reasoning tasks.

method.text: Quiet-STaR 将 STaR 推广到从多样化的非结构化文本中学习推理，训练 LM 生成有助于推断后续文本的理由 [S1.p2]。具体地，论文在每个观察 token 之间引入辅助的 rationale 变量，目标是优化模型以准确预测剩余序列而非仅下一个 token [S3.p1]。为应对挑战，作者提出 tokenwise 并行采样算法、指示 thought 起止的可学习 meta-token、mixing head 以及扩展的 teacher-forcing 技术 [abstract]。mixing head 在带 thought 与不带 thought 的预测之间学习插值，以平滑过渡 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: we extend STaR – instead of the LM learning to reason on particular tasks like mathematical QA, we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus.
we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence.
Also note that we formulate the objective as accurately predicting the remaining sequence, rather than only the next token.
we propose a tokenwise parallel sampling algorithm, using learnable tokens indicating a thought’s start and end, and an extended teacher-forcing technique.
we introduce a learned interpolation between the LM predictions with and without thoughts.

experiments.text: 实验以 Mistral 7B 基础版本为起点 [S5.p1]。大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的受益于推理的 token [S5.p2]。同时也在 C4 上评估，使用 16 个 thought token 和 4 个 true token ahead 的设置 [S5.SS1.p2]。评估任务为 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本推理能力 [S5.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4, a widely used LM pretraining corpus with more diverse text, and again show significant albeit smaller benefits.
for our C4 evaluation, we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup.
we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K.

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上继续预训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且性能随理由长度增加而提升 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。与 pause token 微调相比，pause token 在 CommonsenseQA 上从 26.9% 到 28.8%，在 GSM8K 上损害性能，表明多 token 理由比单 token pause 更有效 [S5.SS1.p3]。此外，在零样本 chain-of-thought 中，多数投票准确率（cot-maj@8）从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
Similarly, on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model, and once again, performance scales with the length of the rationales generated during Quiet-STaR training.
training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin.
they observed an improvement from 26.9% to 28.8%; on GSM8K, found that pause token fine-tuning harms performance.
This suggests that allowing the model to generate multi-token rationales leads to more effective reasoning compared to the single-token ”pauses”.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.

limitations.text: 作者承认，为应对各种元学习挑战而做了简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术从零训练模型时是否有效，且仅将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前需生成许多 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由 [S6.p2]。此外，无法知道模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（忠实性），且若模型发现有害或有偏的推理模式有用，也没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch.
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
